comments.quote: The hotel is simple, very clean and the lady at the reception Ms. Xiao Jia was really fantastic on support us. I strongly recommend this hotel because the location is fantastic and the service super.
comments.author: Roberto Vitri

comments.quote: The location is extremely convenient, right near the transfer center, and Jianchi Pond is just a short walk away. The hotel's restaurant is also quite good. A special shout-out to the receptionist; from the pre-check-in communication to the check-in assistance...
comments.author: westchen

comments.quote: The room is great. The environment is also very good. There is a terrace. The service is especially good. The lady is very enthusiastic. My bag was lost and she kept helping me contact people. She introduced us to restaurants...
